instruction: Look at freecad_task-5_input.step in FreeCAD. Use the Part Design workbench throughout; activate the Body, create new sketches on the required faces or planes, and complete all fused features in the same Body using GUI additive and subtractive features. Make a detailed electronics enclosure from the solid 150 x 90 x 45 mm blank. Cut a top-opening internal cavity 118 x 58 mm centered at (75,45), depth 38 mm, leaving a 7 mm bottom floor. Add four internal cylindrical standoffs fused to the floor at (35,25), (115,25), (35,65), and (115,65), each diameter 16 mm and height 24 mm from Z=7 to Z=31. Drill a blind vertical hole of diameter 5 mm and depth 18 mm into the top of each standoff. Cut a front connector window 36 x 14 mm through the Y=0 wall centered at X=75 and Z=23, a rear window 50 x 12 mm through the Y=90 wall centered at X=75 and Z=26, and matching side service windows 24 x 12 mm through both X side walls centered at Y=45 and Z=26. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-5_output.step. Use only interactive GUI operations and no external scripts.
